title: Length is additive in short exact sequences
statement: Let $R$ be a ring and let $0\to M'\xrightarrow{f}M\xrightarrow{g}M''\to0$ be a short exact sequence of $R$-modules ($f$ injective, $g$ surjective, $\operatorname{Im}f=\operatorname{Ker}g$). Then $\mathrm{length}_R(M)=\mathrm{length}_R(M')+\mathrm{length}_R(M'')$ in $\{0,1,2,\dots\}\cup\{\infty\}$ (with $n+\infty=\infty+n=\infty$), where $\mathrm{length}_R$ is the length of [def-weil-pbc-module-length]. In particular $M$ has finite length if and only if $M'$ and $M''$ both do.
